obligation_candidates.canon_label: Bridge envelope in CLI_Bridged_Providers.md must carry: effective_account_id, execution_role, actor_kind, lane_id, worktree_id when the bridged provider is called in a multi-actor context
exact_tokens: Bridge envelope in CLI_Bridged_Providers.md must carry: effective_account_id, execution_role, actor_kind, lane_id, worktree_id when the bridged provider is called in a multi-actor context
Bridged-provider usage events must include OperationalIdentity fields; bare bridge events without attribution are invisible to governance/audit
OpenCode SSE must be lane-filtered: events from actor A must not leak to actor B's SSE stream even in the same server process
notes: OpenCode SSE lane contamination is a data isolation and governance failure under multi-actor execution
